app.name: Tautua
app.subtitle: O se tusi faʻasino i tū ma aganuʻu, faʻamatai, ma faʻalavelave — mo le ʻau Sāmoa o loʻo nofo i fafo.
app.principle: O le ala i le pule o le tautua.
app.principle.context: O le mataupu silisili o le aganuʻu Sāmoa, ma o le agāga o lenei tusi faʻasino.
lang.label: Gagana
home.quick.title: O le ā le mea o loʻo tupu?
home.quick.subtitle: Filifili le mea e te alu i ai ma matou te taʻitaʻi atu ai.
home.modules.title: O le tusi faʻasino
home.modules.subtitle: Suʻesuʻe i vaega uma o tū, sauniga, ma le gagana.
search.empty: Leai se faʻaiʻuga. Taumafai i se isi upu.
wizard.title: Taʻiala o Tū
wizard.subtitle: Taʻu mai le sauniga, lou tofi, ma le mea e te manaʻo e iloa.
wizard.step.question: O le ā le mea e te manaʻo e iloa?
wizard.noAnswer: E leʻi maua se tali patino. Talanoa pea ma lou matai mo le aiga ma le nuʻu.
modules.faamatai.desc: Suafa, tofi, ma le faʻaogaina o le faʻamatai.
modules.ceremonies.desc: Faʻasologa o faʻaipoipoga, maliu, saofaʻi, ma isi.
modules.faalavelave.desc: Tiute, mea alofa, ma le faʻafetai.
modules.ava.desc: O le sauniga o le ʻava, tofi i tofi.
modules.phrases.desc: Faʻaupuga e lua gagana ma faaleoga.
modules.ietoga.desc: Uiga, vasega, ma le faʻaaliga o ʻie tōga.
modules.dress.desc: Mea e ofuina i sauniga eseese.
modules.glossary.desc: Upu uma i gagana e lua.
modules.library.title: Vaega o le tusi faʻasino
modules.library.subtitle: O sauniga ma le faʻamatalaga atoa o tū, faʻamatai, ma le faʻalavelave.
glossary.subtitle: O upu uma o loʻo aoga i totonu o le tusi faʻasino, faʻasoa i gagana e lua.
phrases.subtitle: Faʻaupuga aloaʻia ma masani, faʻasoa i gagana e lua ma le faaleoga.
variesByNuu.label: E fesuiaʻi e tusa ai ma le nuʻu.
variesByNuu.note: Talanoa ma matai o lou aiga po o le nuʻu mo tū faʻapitoa.
review.title: Tuʻuina atu mo le iloiloga
review.subtitle: Tuʻuina atu mea faʻaliliu uma mo le iloiloga e matai aʻo leʻi faʻasalalauina i tagata lautele. O loʻo taʻu atu foʻi mea faʻapitoa ua mātauina e fesuiaʻi e tusa ai ma le nuʻu.
review.previewNote: O loʻo vaʻai i lalo le ata o lau faʻaliliuga atoa.
review.corrections.title: O le faiga o le faʻasaʻoga
review.corrections.step1: Lomi po o tuʻuina atu lenei tusi i se matai, faifeʻau, po o se taʻitaʻi o le aganuʻu mo le iloiloga.
review.corrections.step2a: O faʻasaʻoga e faʻailoa mai e tusia i le faila
review.corrections.step2b: o se taʻiala mo suafa taʻitasi.
review.corrections.step3: Pe a maea ona faʻaaogāina se taʻiala ma le tulaga ua faamaonia, o le a faʻaali atu le faʻailoga ʻCommunity Reviewedʼ i lea mea i totonu o le app.
bookmarks.title: Ua teu
bookmarks.empty: Leai se mea ua teu. Tago i le faʻailoga teu i soʻo se itulau.
reviewBadge.label: Ua talia e le aganuʻu
footer.principle: O le ala i le pule o le tautua.
footer.note: O Tautua o se taʻiala mo le atunuʻu. Ia talafeagai pea ma fautuaga a lou aiga, matai, ma faifeʻau.
